page.overview:
Who is Benjamin Franklin Pierce?

Captain Benjamin Franklin Pierce was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2364, he was the commander of the . Early that year, he received an order about transporting personnel from Starbase 55 to the from Captain B.J. Hunnicutt of Starfleet Operational Support Services. The captain was requested to send acknowledgement of his receipt of the order through subspace com net security mode 045, code 100 alpha. (, okudagram)
